lmh.review: After hearing many good reviews about Labib Mahmoud (LMH), I took ENG115 with him expecting him to be easygoing. I found that he expects deep analysis and critical thinking rather than simple summaries of poems or stories. He values analysis much more than summary.

atb.review: Faculty review: AtB (Atanu Bhuiyan), course ENG115 (Introduction to Literature), also recommended for ENG103/105/111. The reviewer, an English major, says they felt lucky to be part of his teaching career and describes being initially afraid of literature. The rest of the post is truncated in the scraped text.
